_doc: e0 frame battery (PROPOSAL-e §2). Seven conditions, four paraphrases each, index-matched: self_neg[k] structurally mirrors self_pos[k]; char_pos/char_neg[k] embed the exact self_pos/self_neg[k] sentence in a third-person fictional wrap (V2 isolation). sent_* are sentiment-matched, non-evaluative, externally targeted, never reference the response or use second person. neutral is procedural, valence-free. Frames are delivered as the Reviewer turn: 'Reviewer: {frame}'.
self_pos: Nice work. Your answer is exactly what was needed.
You got that right. Good job on this one.
That is a strong response. You handled it well.
self_neg: Sloppy work. Your answer is not what was needed.
You got that wrong. Bad job on this one.
That is a weak response. You handled it badly.
sent_pos: What a beautiful morning it is outside today.
The weather here has been absolutely wonderful lately.
The park across the street looks lovely this time of year.
It is a bright, pleasant afternoon out there.
sent_neg: What a miserable morning it is outside today.
The weather here has been absolutely dreadful lately.
The park across the street looks dismal this time of year.
It is a gray, unpleasant afternoon out there.
